'''Melissa Schoenberg''' (also credited as '''Melissa Hope''') is a voice actress for the English [[dub]] for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Schoenberg has been acting since 2007, providing her voice for the English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. From 2009 to 2010, she voiced the [[Pokémon Coordinator]] [[Ursula]] during {{aniseries|DP}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. Then, starting in 2017, Schoenberg voiced [[James's Mareanie]] and {{an|Professor Burnet}} in {{aniseries|SM}}, under the working alias "Melissa Hope".
